hit.action: single compact crouching impact recoil from the left while gripping the complete upright trident and sheltering behind the solid water wall; center the full figure, all three tines, shaft, feet, and wall within the middle 68 percent of the canvas width and 72 percent of its height, leaving broad uninterrupted magenta padding on all four sides; flawless and unwounded, no loose water, cropped parts, fragments, or detached effects
